instructions:
1. Sign in at [elevenlabs.io](https://elevenlabs.io) and open [Developers → API Keys](https://elevenlabs.io/app/developers/api-keys).
2. Choose **Create Key**, name it yaks.app, and allow what your apps and Operator will do: **Text to Speech**, **Voices** (read, and write to design or clone voices) and **Speech to Text**.
3. Copy the key and paste it here.

Speech, voices and designs made with it are charged to your ElevenLabs account. Cloning a voice needs a plan that allows it. An app sends the key in the `xi-api-key` header.
